markt.rating.ausblick.text: The agencies signal that the next review may change the grade if the situation persists.
markt.rating.herab.text: The rating agencies see more risk than before ({von} → {nach}): loans become dearer and investors pull back. {anlagegrad, select, ja {Investment grade is preserved.} other {Investment grade is far out of reach.}}
markt.rating.herauf.text: The rating agencies see less risk ({von} → {nach}): loans become cheaper and capital returns. {anlagegrad, select, ja {The country has reached investment grade: pension and sovereign funds may buy again.} other {Investment grade remains the next goal.}}
markt.schock.justiz.hoch.text: Whoever steers judges and cases weakens the protection of contracts: the risk premium rises by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.justiz.hoch.titel: Interference with the judiciary costs trust in the markets.
markt.schock.justiz.tief.text: Reliable courts lower the risk: the risk premium falls by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.justiz.tief.titel: A more independent judiciary calms investors.
markt.schock.notstand.hoch.text: Special powers and restricted rights count as a risk for contracts and property: the risk premium jumps by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.notstand.hoch.titel: The state of emergency frightens investors.
markt.schock.notstand.tief.text: Normal rules lower the risk: the risk premium falls by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.notstand.tief.titel: The end of special powers calms investors.
markt.schock.presse.hoch.text: Where criticism falls silent, investors get worse information: the risk premium rises by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.presse.hoch.titel: Interference with the press clouds the investment climate.
markt.schock.presse.tief.text: The signal of a free press lowers the risk: the risk premium falls by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.presse.tief.titel: The release of the journalists calms the markets.
markt.schock.reform.hoch.text: Whoever withdraws commitments loses credibility: the risk premium rises by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.reform.hoch.titel: A setback on reform unsettles the markets.
markt.schock.reform.tief.text: Reliable rules lower the risk: the risk premium falls by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.reform.tief.titel: A reform step strengthens investor confidence.
markt.schock.verfassung.hoch.text: A rebuilding of the distribution of power counts as a risk to predictability: the risk premium rises by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.verfassung.hoch.titel: The constitutional change unsettles the markets.
markt.schock.verfassung.tief.text: Clearer checks on power lower the risk: the risk premium falls by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.verfassung.tief.titel: The constitutional change strengthens market confidence.
markt.schock.verhaftung.hoch.text: Investors read the move against opposition figures as a sign of fading legal certainty: the risk premium jumps by about {cds} basis points and the central bank supports the lira from its reserves.
markt.schock.verhaftung.tief.text: Less confrontation lowers the risk: the risk premium falls by about {cds} basis points.
markt.schock.verhaftung.tief.titel: The easing around the detainees calms the markets.
markt.schock.wahl.hoch.text: A narrow or contested result makes investors recalculate: the risk premium rises by about {cds} basis points and the lira weakens.
markt.schock.wahl.hoch.titel: Markets react nervously to the election result.
markt.schock.wahl.tief.text: Predictability helps: the risk premium falls by about {cds} basis points and the lira firms up.
markt.schock.wahl.tief.titel: A clear election result calms the markets.
